notes: Reconciliation: in the anarthrous μόνῳ θεῷ the supplied determiner and the dative case preposition belong to the noun, so μόνῳ is bare “only” and θεῷ takes the discontinuous “to the … God”. This unifies it with JUD.1.18 (ἐσχάτου “last” / χρόνου “the time”) and with the corpus, which puts the supplied determiner on an expressed noun rather than on an attributive adjective 21 times to 1, and never renders μόνος as “the only” in 20 occurrences.
